events.content:
I built the landing page in `src/App.tsx`. The project already had Gravity UI set up, so I used its components (`Text`, `Card`, `Button`, `Flex`) and added no new dependencies. `npm run build` (TypeScript check plus Vite build) passes. I didn't look at it in a browser because no browser tool is installed here, so I haven't seen how it looks. To check it, run `npm run dev`.

**What's on the page:**
- **Hero:** the heading "TeamClock — учёт времени для команд" and one line of subheading. It has no button, so the page keeps a single CTA.
- **Three benefits** as outlined cards: one-click time tracking, a clear view of team workload, and ready-made reports. The cards sit in one row and wrap into a column on narrow screens.
- **CTA at the end:** a short heading and an "Попробовать бесплатно" button.

**Things to know:**
- "TeamClock" and all the copy are placeholders; replace them with your own.
- The button links to `/signup`, a placeholder set in the `SIGNUP_URL` constant at the top of the file. Change it to your real signup address.
- In `index.html` I changed the page language to `ru` and set the page title.

There's no navigation, reviews, pricing, forms, animations or custom graphics.

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/layout/; grep -o "'display-[0-9]'\|'header-[0-9]'\|'subheader-[0-9]'\|'body-[0-9]'" build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n "gap\|direction\|wrap\|centerContent\|alignItems" | head; grep -n "maxWidth\|gutters" build/esm/components/layout/Container/Container.d.ts

grep -rho "display-[0-9]\|header-[0-9]\|subheader-[0-9]\|body-[0-9]" build/esm/components/Text/text/*.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "size\|view\|href" build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "view\|type" build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n "MediaType\b.*=" -r build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/; s#<title>Gravity UI eval</title>#<title>TeamClock — учёт времени для команд</title>#' index.html && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
grep -n "type Space" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts; sed -i 's/gap={16}/gap={4}/' src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
grep -o "\.g-text{[^}]*}" dist/assets/*.css | head -3; grep -c "margin" dist/assets/*.css; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"

sed -i -E 's/(variant="(display-2|header-1|header-2)" as="h[12]")>/\1 style={{ margin: 0 }}>/' src/App.tsx && grep -n 'as="h' src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -2 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
